messages:
Zoe (SDR): Hi everyone, starting today! I'm missing HubSpot access, Dialer number, and can't find the Finance vertical battle cards mentioned in the welcome email. Who should I ping to get these sorted and where are the short scripts for cold outreach?

onboarding-bot: Welcome Zoe (SDR) to #sales! Buddy assigned: Aisha. Check your inbox for the onboarding checklist.

Maya (Sales Ops): Welcome Zoe! HubSpot invite just sent to zoe@redwood.ai. Finance vertical bundle lives in Drive > Sales > Verticals > Finance. Quick link: https://redwood.link/finance-bundle. Which Dialer region do you need?

Zoe (SDR): US-East preferred. Also the welcome email referenced a 1-page "finance quick sell" card 16 can't find it in the Drive folder.

Felix (Enablement): Zoe 16 that one-pager is a gated doc (we only expose higher-risk case studies internally). I added a copy to the bundle and a trimmed A6 quick-card for prints. Use "Finance Quick Sell v1" (Confluence) for the 30s opener.

Owen (IT): @Zoe I provisioned a US-East DID + softphone. Dialer invite coming from dialer@redwood.ai; accept and then pick your caller ID preference. If you want the number displayed as "Redwood - Finance" tell me now.

Zoe (SDR): Caller ID as "Redwood - Finance" please. Also, HubSpot shows me but I can't see the company property "Annual Spend" that Enablement referenced.

Maya (Sales Ops): I forgot to add that custom property to your profile. Added now 16 refresh HubSpot and you should see "Annual Spend" under company properties. If it's still missing, clear cache or try incognito.

Zoe (SDR): I see it now, thanks. Dialer invite says "pending" though.

Owen (IT): Resent the Dialer invite and forced a token refresh. If it still says pending in 5 min I'll escalate telecom ticket TEL-912. Also FYI: if you use the Chrome softphone extension please enable microphone permissions in browser settings.

Felix (Enablement): Regarding scripts 16 the "Finance 3-touch" cadence and objection-handling snippets are in Confluence: https://redwood.link/finance-cadence. Short tip: open with a 2-line stat about ROI then ask about budget owner.

Zoe (SDR): Helpful, thanks. One more: who approves outbound email templates referencing logos or customer names? I want to reference a case study in a sequence.

Maya (Sales Ops): Legal review required for using customer logos or naming. Email legal-ops@redwood.com and copy me; they typically reply within 48h. If it's a standard customer case we've got pre-approved snippets in the bundle.

printing-bot: Printing request created: job #PRINT-331 for 25 A6 "Finance Quick Sell" cards, pickup at HQ Mailroom.

Zoe (SDR): Dialer invite accepted 16 softphone working and HubSpot call log shows the number. Everything else looks good, appreciate the fast help!

Maya (Sales Ops): Great! I'll schedule a 30-min shadow with an experienced finance SDR tomorrow at 11am ET. Welcome aboard :tada:
